parameters.query:
insert into public.tc_audit_events
(org_id, actor, entity_type, entity_id, action, before_state, after_state)
values
($1, 'system', 'expense_record', $2, 'CREATED_OR_UPDATED', null, $3::jsonb);

select
  d.org_id,
  d.id as document_id,
  o.raw_text,
  o.ocr_confidence
from tc_documents d
join tc_doc_ocr_runs o
  on o.document_id = d.id
where d.id = $1
  and d.org_id = $2
order by o.created_at desc
limit 1;
